sources.repository-tests: scripts/tests/test_worker.py and scripts/tests/test_worktree_prune.py; CLI/API mocks, not live sessions. Installed audit versions: Claude Code 2.1.322, Codex CLI 0.167.1, OpenCode v2.2.5.
sources.worker-live-visibility: Local smoke evidence on 2026-11-11: Codex native task was listed by the current TUI and executed pwd/branch checks in its assigned worktree; OpenCode created, read, listed, and deleted a sibling-worktree session without a model turn. Claude native listing shape checked against the installed CLI; new launch validation uses mocked regression tests.
sources.worktree-local-configuration: Repository fixture tests cover explicit and Claude-hook creation, sibling-master source selection, current/future backend resource paths, preserved destinations, shared edits, ignore checks, private output, failure retention and source preservation on removal. No backend API or CLI contract changes.
sources.orca-api: Orca 1.4.261: bundled CLI and orchestration guides, recovery reference and installed command schemas. Worker launch, mutation replay IDs, same-chat follow-up assignment transfer, guarded release and non-forced workspace removal validated locally. orca.yaml parsed with the installed setup resolver.
sources.development-setup-tests: scripts/tests/test_dev_setup.py and test_worktree_prune.py: setup preflight/failure propagation and WORKTREE-007 existing-checkout linking. Runtime setup starts no services; Gradle frontend development-server arguments checked separately.
sources.orca-worker-tests: scripts/tests/test_orca_worker.py: ORCAWORKER-001 through ORCAWORKER-008 contract fixtures. Disposable live Codex structured-chat smoke verified workspace identity, same-conversation continuation, approval-phase cleanup refusal and release/workspace/branch removal. Terminal and other backend combinations use contract tests, not a claim of live parity. Project-selection regression fixtures cover duplicate checkout registrations, hidden projects, archived workspaces, explicit selection and continuation after a project is hidden.

codex.detail: Generator installs repository skills in .agents/skills; no .codex/config.toml or execution rules are installed.

opencode.detail: Generator writes opencode.json commands and permissions in V2 schema.

orca.detail: Committed orca.yaml declares the setup command and wait-for-setup startup policy. Base ref and external worktree visibility remain repository settings. Reuse existing backend workflow adapters.

claude.detail: Shared script supports explicit operations and Claude hook entry points. New worktrees link ignored backend application-local.yml files from sibling master at matching resource paths, including future applications.

codex.detail: Shared script is required for repository worktree operations. New worktrees link ignored backend application-local.yml files from sibling master at matching resource paths, including future applications.

opencode.detail: Shared script is required for repository worktree operations. New worktrees link ignored backend application-local.yml files from sibling master at matching resource paths, including future applications.

claude.detail: Uses --bg/--name/--session-id, then validates the returned job ID, conversation UUID, name and worktree in claude agents --json --all.

codex.detail: Creates an independent interactive task on the existing local shared app-server daemon; binds the returned ID before its first turn and validates native listing visibility, name, cwd, sandbox and approval routing. Never falls back to exec or a private server.

opencode.detail: Creates a top-level V2 session on the UI shared service, verifies its identity/name/worktree and paginated native listing before command submission; optional --server is retained.

orca.detail: worker.py --host auto|orca launches one supervised Orca worker in an existing shared-script workspace and verifies assignment, backend and conversation identity. Follows Chat/CLI preference; protects status before launch and retains replay receipts. Resolves the checkout in the caller's project registration and rejects hidden projects and archived workspaces; explicit workspace selection remains available.

claude.detail: Launch prompt expands canonical /plan, /implement, or /lightweight template with worker-local gates.

codex.detail: Sends the expanded canonical prompt through turn/start on the recorded native task, after worktree protection and identity binding.

opencode.detail: V2 session command endpoint runs the generated command.

orca.detail: Expand canonical workflow prompts in worker.py and deliver through Orca spec-file stdin. Workers report assignment outcomes at pauses without marking repository work complete or granting approval.

claude.detail: Separate --agent and --model; named background agents require Claude >= 2.1.191 and reject unavailable selections.

codex.detail: Named-agent selection remains unsupported and is rejected; use explicit --default-agent. CODEX_THREAD_ID or --parent-session inherits the current task configuration/model through a native fork; optional --model overrides it. Forked tasks are independent, not child subagents.

opencode.detail: Checks primary-capable named agent and independently forwards provider/model with optional variant.

orca.detail: Orca transport maps Codex, Claude and OpenCode V2 to codex, claude and opencode2. It preserves supported model selection and uses Orca backend permissions; named-agent, sandbox, socket/fork and explicit server overrides are rejected before launch.

claude.detail: Protects lifecycle before claude attach with recorded background job ID.

codex.detail: Protects lifecycle and verifies effective native cwd/sandbox/approval routing, then opens the exact task on its recorded socket using codex --remote. Legacy exec workers retain explicit-ID CLI resume; ignored loaded-task overrides fail without changing the recorded mode.

opencode.detail: Protects lifecycle, verifies native session visibility, and reopens the recorded session on the same shared service, forwarding any recorded --server.

orca.detail: worker.py resume preserves repository approval gates and continues the recorded Orca conversation. Follow-up Task/Dispatch identities replace prior assignment IDs while conversation identity is verified; unresolved operations use recorded mutation IDs through recover.

claude.detail: claude rm deletes the recorded background job; saved conversation transcript is retained.

codex.detail: Native task cleanup sends thread/delete for the exact recorded UUID to its recorded daemon socket. Legacy exec workers retain codex delete --force; no broad session discovery.

opencode.detail: V2 DELETE targets only the recorded session, forwarding any recorded --server.

orca.detail: After repository lifecycle/PR/Git checks, cleanup releases only the recorded Orca assignment and removes its exact empty workspace without force or archive hooks. Retained, unknown and unrelated resources block cleanup; checkpoints preserve retry identity.

claude.detail: Shared status file and script checks; approval gates are workflow instructions, not permission enforcement.

codex.detail: Status validates persisted sandbox and native transport identity against the registry; native execution uses on-request approvals with automatic review. Sandbox danger-full-access removes filesystem/network enforcement; workflow plan/commit gates remain separate.

opencode.detail: Shared status file and script checks; approval gates are workflow instructions, not permission enforcement.

orca.detail: Repository .worker-status.json remains the lifecycle authority, independent of Orca Task completion. Guarded Orca resource operations run only after cleanup eligibility. Status exposes the host and persisted identities.

codex.detail: Local shared-daemon WebSocket JSON-RPC over a Unix control socket; checks native interactive listing after initial user-message persistence. Requires a running UI daemon. Remote WebSocket servers are unsupported: run on the UI server host and select its local socket. UI tasks are independent; no subagent parentage is claimed.

claude.detail: Codex-specific transport is not applicable. Claude uses native background sessions and agent view instead.

opencode.detail: Codex-specific transport is not applicable. OpenCode uses its shared V2 service and native session inventory instead.

orca.detail: Codex-specific native control is not an Orca worker transport. Repository Codex workers continue to use their documented native transport.

claude.detail: Run bash scripts/dev-setup.sh in the checkout: check JDK 25, Python venv/virtualenv and Docker, link local configuration, install Gradle-managed frontend dependencies. Verification remains explicit.

codex.detail: Run bash scripts/dev-setup.sh in the checkout: check JDK 25, Python venv/virtualenv and Docker, link local configuration, install Gradle-managed frontend dependencies. Verification remains explicit.

opencode.detail: Run bash scripts/dev-setup.sh in the checkout: check JDK 25, Python venv/virtualenv and Docker, link local configuration, install Gradle-managed frontend dependencies. Verification remains explicit.

orca.detail: orca.yaml runs bash scripts/dev-setup.sh and waits for setup before starting an agent. Existing external worktrees run setup explicitly; setup prepares dependencies and local configuration without starting application services.
